annotations.title: Provision Dedicated Telecom & Voice AI Numbers

description: Search available E.164 phone numbers, provision dedicated telecom numbers ($1.50/mo vs $59/mo legacy bundles), list active numbers, or bind a number to a SIP/WebRTC Voice AI Agent trunk. Use this tool when an AI agent needs a dedicated SMS, WhatsApp Business Cloud, or inbound/outbound voice phone number in the US, Spain, UAE, UK, or EU. Returns available or provisioned `TelecomNumber` records with capabilities (`sms`, `voice`, `whatsapp`) and SIP trunk URIs.

action.description: Telecom number operation: 'search_available' lists purchasable E.164 numbers by country, 'provision' activates a dedicated number ($1.50/mo), 'configure_sip_voice_agent' attaches a SIP URI and voice prompt, and 'list' returns active workspace numbers.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code for number search or provisioning (e.g. 'ES' for Spain +34, 'US' for United States +1, 'AE' for UAE +971, 'GB' for UK +44).

numberId.description: Internal telecom number identifier (`num_...`) when configuring SIP routing via `configure_sip_voice_agent`.

phoneNumber.description: Specific E.164 phone number (e.g. '+34919021101' or '+14158904321') to provision when `action` is 'provision'.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) that owns the telecom number.

sipTrunkUri.description: Destination SIP or WebRTC trunk URI (e.g. 'sip:voice-agent@sip.nuntior.com') for routing live inbound/outbound AI voice calls.

voiceAgentPrompt.description: System instructions and persona prompt for the realtime AI Voice Agent answering or placing calls on this number.
